$comment: Plan 20 stage-2 route pilot: 12 frozen cases on the p41 lighthouse cast (synthetic). 8 single, 4 pairs; close and full views, one changed outfit (Ash's prepared navy-coat look), difficult lighting, two-character interactions, the story's lighthouse rooms. Frozen 2026-10-26: edit only with a new pilot round.

ash.coat: a long navy wool coat over the jacket

lines: I hold my hands out to the stove. Ash, you look frozen.
Ash leans in close to the iron stove, rubbing her hands in the warm glow and grinning through chattering teeth.
cases.moment: Ash close up at the iron stove, warming her hands, warm lamplight

lines: Is the boat still out there?
Ash presses a palm to the rain-streaked window, squinting into the black sea as lightning flickers behind the glass.
cases.moment: Ash at a rain-streaked window at night, looking out to sea, lightning behind the glass

cases.light: single lantern in a dark stairwell
lines: Lead the way up, I'll follow.
Ash climbs the spiral staircase two steps at a time, a swinging lantern held high in one hand.
cases.moment: Ash full body climbing the spiral lighthouse staircase holding a lantern

cases.light: grey storm daylight from the doorway

set.ash_outfit: a long navy wool coat over the jacket

lines: Ash stamps into the entrance hall and shakes rain off her long navy wool coat, laughing at the puddle she leaves.
cases.moment: Ash in her long navy coat at the lighthouse door, shaking off rain

cases.light: bright lens glow against a dark storm
lines: Can I help with the lamp?
Bram trims the great lamp's wick, the huge glass lens throwing white light across his weathered face.
cases.moment: Bram trimming the great lamp's wick in the lamp room, lens glow on his face

lines: Bram pours tea from a dented kettle into a chipped mug, eyebrows raised in a quiet joke.
cases.moment: Bram close up pouring tea into a chipped mug at the kitchen table

lines: Cleo kneels among stacks of old logbook boxes, holding one open by candlelight and adjusting her glasses.
cases.moment: Cleo full body kneeling among boxes of old logbooks, reading one by candlelight

lines: Cleo flinches at the window as a lightning flash turns the room cold blue, a notebook clutched to her chest.
cases.moment: Cleo at the window flinching at a lightning flash, notebook clutched to her chest

lines: The oil crate goes up to the lamp room.
Ash takes the front of the heavy oil crate while Bram lifts the back, both straining as they start up the stairs.
cases.moment: Ash and Bram carrying a heavy wooden oil crate up the stairs together

lines: Cleo spreads a sea chart across the table and points to a reef while Ash leans over her shoulder, frowning.
cases.moment: Cleo pointing at a sea chart on the table while Ash leans over her shoulder

lines: Bram hauls on the old brass storm bell's rope while Cleo winces and covers her ears beside him.
cases.moment: Bram ringing the brass storm bell while Cleo covers her ears

cases.light: storm light through the lamp room glass

set.ash_outfit: a long navy wool coat over the jacket

lines: Bram and Ash, in her long navy coat, stand at the lamp room window watching the waves, Bram pointing at the horizon.
